sources.source_type: Primary peer-reviewed clinical letter; public full article PDF

sources.supporting_paraphrase: Mother/son withKRT16p.Arg127Cys had blinded opposite-foot comparisons with erlotinib/vehicle plus keratolytic, followed by uncontrolled extensions. Mobility narrative belongs to uncontrolled extension
Co-treatment and formulation cannot be dropped from claim
No measured systemic exposure or commercial product qualification
